extracted.intended_audience: members of the media and the general public interested in the Boys & Girls Clubs 'Youth of the Year' program
extracted.subtask_short: Youth of the Year media requests
extracted.subtask_description: Information for media about the Youth of the Year program, including how the selection works and the values/criteria Club members must demonstrate to attain Youth of the Year titles at local, state, regional, and national levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leadership and service
rubrics_metrics.description: To achieve the title of Youth of the Year on any level, Club members must embody the values of leadership and service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated as one of the core values required for selection; candidates should demonstrate leadership and service in their Clubs and communities. This value is presented alongside academic excellence and healthy lifestyles as essential selection dimensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic excellence
rubrics_metrics.description: To achieve the title of Youth of the Year on any level, Club members must embody the values of ... academic excellence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Academic achievement is an explicit selection criterion—candidates are expected to demonstrate strong scholastic performance as part of the Youth of the Year evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Healthy lifestyles
rubrics_metrics.description: To achieve the title of Youth of the Year on any level, Club members must embody the values of ... healthy lifestyles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Healthy lifestyles (presumably covering physical, emotional, and/or behavioral wellness) are named as a core value for selection alongside leadership/service and academic excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multilevel selection process (local → state → regional → national)
rubrics_metrics.description: The journey to being named National Youth of the Year begins locally and progresses to state, regional and national levels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection is a staged process; to achieve the title at any level, candidates must meet the stated values. The progression implies that evaluation occurs at multiple levels with advancing winners representing Clubs at higher levels of competition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role expectations for National Youth of the Year
rubrics_metrics.description: Each year, one exceptional Club youth is selected as the National Youth of the Year. Over the ensuing one-year term, he or she serves as both an exemplary ambassador for Boys & Girls Club youth and as a strong voice for all of our nation’s young people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection favors candidates who can represent the organization publicly and advocate for youth; the National title carries ambassadorial and advocacy responsibilities during a one-year term.
